title: Content Brief
description: Structured fact package produced by a source extractor (see ../prompts/session-brief.md, ../prompts/hype-brief.md). sp-content-gen writes drafts ONLY from a brief; an empty or thin brief is refused by the brief gate in the workflow.

source_type.description: Which extractor produced the brief. session = Devin session history + repo. hype = trend-scout link/group discussion, short expert commentary. hot-topic = popular topic + own project context as example. retro = archive photo/event via archive_content_guide.md.

topic.description: One-line subject of the future post.

type.description: Link kind: repo = project repository, issue = task/bug reference, pr = pull request, doc = documentation or spec.

url.description: Public URL. Must be verifiable - the extractor only lists links it actually saw.

label.description: Short human label, e.g. 'ai_trading repo' or 'issue #9 mean reversion backtest'.

links.description: Verifiable public links the writer may reference (never invent URLs - only these may appear in drafts).

scope.description: Bounds of the article: what this post covers and, implicitly, what it does NOT cover. The writer must stay inside it.

accents.description: Emphasis points: 1-5 angles/details the writer must foreground (e.g. 'the no-sudo constraint', 'deterministic math over LLM').

facts.description: Verifiable facts. Every fact should carry a concrete number, version, name of a library/method, or a measurable claim - no generalities. If a fact cannot be verified against the source material, it does not belong here.

arc.description: The story arc of the work - what makes it a story and not an info digest. All fields optional, keep honest failures.

failure.description: What broke, was falsified or had to be thrown away.

media.description: Local paths to images/screenshots usable in the post (e.g. materials/photos/...). Paths must exist on the machine running the pipeline.

platform_fit.description: Platforms this brief can serve. Extractor picks; the caller may subset it.

retro.description: true when the content is archival (old photo, past event) - such posts must be openly marked as retrospective, never presented as current work.

forbidden_claims.description: Claims that must NOT appear in drafts: unverified metrics, employer data, private hosts/paths, things that look true but were not confirmed in the source.

author_notes.description: Free-form context for the writer: tone hints, what NOT to emphasize, audience angle.
